chr_0037_minghe.name: Argent Flow
chr_0037_minghe.quote: Argent Flow of HAS, at your service. Captain of Pacified Skies? That title serves little purpose here, so let's just drop it and avoid confusion.
chr_0037_minghe.profile:
"Suited up and ready. There will be no holding back."

Argent Flow, Imperial Guard of Yan and Captain of Pacified Skies of Hongshan Academy of Sciences. With sword in hand, he spurs his galloper, Nuli, forward like a bolt of lightning across the northern front lines, leaving countless legends in his wake. Yet beyond the legends, he is not nearly as aloof as people make him out to be. As he journeys across mountains and rivers, he never hesitates to lend a hand whenever he encounters someone in need, no matter how small the matter.

He rarely speaks of the past, yet old tales still linger on people's lips: it was you who changed how he wields his sword.

Body of steel, heart of soul. The answer you gave him has illuminated his path through the long night. From here on, he will continue to serve under Tianshi Tan and journey across Talos-II to solve whatever disasters may arise. Sword in hand, he will walk alongside Endfield and carve a path for civilization, until the lights of every home can shine undisturbed by calamity.

"When you need to make a hard decision, I will be at your side. You can have full faith in our bond."

skills.description:
**SKILL DESCRIPTION:** Argent Flow sweeps his lance and deals ⟦phys|Physical DMG⟧ to nearby enemies and applies ⟦key|Lift⟧ to target(s) in front of him.
After Argent Flow casts his combo skill, his battle skill is temporarily changed to ⟦key|Bolt Rush⟧.
⟦key|Bolt Rush⟧: Argent Flow mounts his galloper Nuli to leap into mid-air, powers up quickly, and then charges at the target to forcibly apply ⟦key|Electrification⟧ and deal ⟦elec|Electric DMG⟧ to enemies within a large area in front of him. When this ⟦key|Electrification⟧ is applied on a target with ⟦key|Electric Infliction⟧, it ⟦key|consumes⟧ all ⟦key|Electric Infliction⟧ stacks from the target and grants ⟦key|Electrification⟧ ⟦key|Status Level +1⟧ per 1 stack consumed. After ⟦key|consuming⟧ the target's ⟦key|Electric Infliction⟧, Argent Flow also applies 1 stack of ⟦key|Vulnerability⟧.

skills.name: Heavens Sundered
skills.description:
**SKILL DESCRIPTION:** Argent Flow mounts Nuli and charges with his lance, dealing continuous ⟦elec|Electric DMG⟧ to targets in front of him while impaling and carrying weak enemies before him throughout the charge. After the charge ends, Argent Flow leaps into the air and unleashes a Cleansing Cleave at the ground. The slash deals ⟦elec|Electric DMG⟧ and applies 1 stack of ⟦key|Electric Infliction⟧. Argent Flow then pierces the ground with his lance, applying ⟦key|Crush⟧ and dealing ⟦elec|Electric DMG⟧ to enemies within a large area.
⟦muted|If Argent Flow's ultimate charges into a non-weak enemy (that cannot be impaled and pushed), his charge will end early.⟧
